prompt: El libro ___ leí era bueno. (The book that I read was good.)
hint: Que is the most common relative pronoun for things.

prompt: I don't understand what you're saying. → No entiendo ___ dices.
hint: Lo que = what/the thing that (no specific antecedent noun).

prompt: La profesora de ___ te hablé es brillante. (The teacher about whom I told you is brilliant.)
hint: After a preposition, use quien (not que) for people.

prompt: The building in which I live is old. → El edificio en ___ vivo es antiguo.
hint: After preposition + specific noun antecedent, el que agrees in gender/number.

prompt: La escritora ___ novela gané es famosa. (The writer whose novel I won is famous.)
hint: Cuyo/cuya/cuyos/cuyas = whose; agrees with the possessed noun (novela = fem).
